rows.ownerDirectedAction: Bind statewide composed routes versus local-court application routes, split delivery types where required, and route exact missing local forms or instructions to source work.

whyStopped.blocker: NO_LOCAL_APPLICATION_FORM_IN_CUSTODY, AND THE FILING COURT IS NOT ESTABLISHED
whyStopped.theBindingHalfIsAnswerable: The statewide half is settled by the record and the packet already states it. The compiled Ohio profile src/lib/rcap-engine/compiled/profiles/OH-ohio.json carries the filing rule per statutory section and the packet's own participant-instructions.md states each one rather than delegating it: R.C. 2953.32 -- the sentencing court for an Ohio conviction, or a court of common pleas for an out-of-state or federal conviction; R.C. 2953.33 -- the court where the case was pending, dismissed, resulted in not guilty, or where the grand jury no-billed; R.C. 2953.35 -- the sentencing court.
whyStopped.theLocalHalfIsNot: There is no statewide Ohio application form for any of these sections and the packet's own build-findings.json says so in as many words: 'No statewide mandatory primary application was identified; local-form coverage is an explicit release blocker.' The pleading configuration says the same about the verification: verificationStatute.citation is null with the note 'No statewide verification language is asserted; use the local court form.'
whyStopped.whatIsMissing: the current application form and local filing instructions of the specific Ohio court of common pleas or municipal court that handled the case
whyStopped.whyItCannotBeReducedToOneIdentifier: It is per-court by design. Each Ohio common pleas and municipal court publishes its own application to seal or expunge, and the controlling record names no court for this route -- the routeKey is obligation:track-only:OH:oh_2953_32_sealing, which binds a statutory track and not a venue. Naming a single form identifier here would be inventing one.
whyStopped.theExactUnestablishedFact: the identity of the sentencing or handling court, which is what R.C. 2953.32(B), 2953.33 and 2953.35 each make the filing venue, and which the composed caption depends on
whyStopped.andThereforeAlsoTheCaption: All four delivered pleadings print the caption 'IN THE OHIO COURT THAT HANDLED THE CASE - LOCAL CAPTION MUST BE CONFIRMED' as the court's own name, and each prints six bracketed operator directives inside its numbered allegations: [CHARGE MUST BE CONFIRMED FROM THE CERTIFIED DISPOSITION], [ARRESTING AGENCY MUST BE CONFIRMED], [ARREST DATE TO BE CONFIRMED], [DISPOSITION MUST BE CONFIRMED FROM THE CERTIFIED DISPOSITION], [DISPOSITION DATE TO BE CONFIRMED] and [STATUTORY ELIGIBILITY BASIS MUST BE CONFIRMED AGAINST THE CITED STATUTE AND THE CERTIFIED RECORD]. Each is disclosed to the participant by name in participant-instructions.md, so the packet does not contradict itself; but a placeholder is not a caption, and this lane will not compose a substitute local form to remove it.

whatIsCorrectAndShouldNotBeDisturbed: The BCI companion is byte-identical to the pinned source: 9234ec763403b1ccfbed796dfcf86f29bf7887390d1770460d0bcc9da31fc8cb, matching STATES/OH/04_SUPPORTING_PROCESS/OH__SUPPORT__OH-BCI-SEALING-EXPUNGEMENT-REQUEST__re-sealing-and-or-expungements__REV-UNKNOWN__EN.pdf under MASTER_LIBRARY_SOURCE_DIR. It is not prefilled and the guide says it is not sent before a signed order exists.

The fee is handled as the record allows and no further: the guide states the $50 application fee unless indigent per R.C. 2953.32 and 2953.35, no fee for dismissal, not-guilty and no-bill sealing under 2953.33, then says the additional local court fee is permitted up to $50, is not fixed by statute, and must be asked of the clerk of the filing court. No local fee figure is stated.

Service is answered rather than delegated: the guide states that the participant serves nobody, that the court notifies the prosecutor, and gives the statutory notice and hearing windows per section. It also tells the participant not to complete a certificate of service, and no certificate is generated.
Every bracketed placeholder printed on a pleading is disclosed to the participant by name, with the reason the packet holds no value for it. The guide and the pages agree in both directions.

It reaches that by a carve-out: invisibleWrites and visualDefects are nulled only when at least one artifact record exists but carries neither output-byte glyph reading, and this family has NO reports/actual-writes.json at all, so artifactRecords.length === 0 and the nulling is skipped entirely. The carve-out's own stated justification is that 'a zero-source composition binds no document bytes by design'. This family is not that: it binds NINE delivered PDFs by SHA-256 in reports/rendered-artifacts.json, one of which carries a live RASTER_PASS acceptance receipt bound to its exact digest. So two counters are published as measured zeros for a family where nobody measured them. This lane publishes them as null, which is what they are, and did not change the shared verifier.

whyStopped.theExactQuestion: For the RCW 9.96.060(6) substance-use-disorder vacate pathway, which election on CrRLJ 09.0100 (rev. 11/2024), if any, states that ground -- section 7 as an offence not otherwise specified, or does this route require a different or modified pleading?
whyStopped.whereThatQuestionIsAlreadyRecorded: data/rcap-all50/overlays/census-v1/wa/wa-vac-substance-use-disorder-set--official-pdf-fill/route-options-block.json, field theExactQuestion, recorded by FIX10 on 2026-09-02 under assignment FABLE-R21. This lane re-read the form and reproduces the finding rather than restating it.
whyStopped.whatWasReadFirstHandByThisLane: CrRLJ 09.0100 rev. 11/2024, sha256 1f72e901e93d576cf6c7ecad910d253da65b6af1a89ca75304c9739fa159909b, resolved by digest under MASTER_LIBRARY_SOURCE_DIR. Its four printed elections are section 3 Conviction as Victim (page 1), section 5 Prior Offense keyed to RCW 46.61.5055 (page 2), section 6 Domestic Violence (page 4) and section 7 Offenses not otherwise specified above (page 4). No printed section names RCW 9.96.060(6).
whyStopped.theNamedWrongAnswer: The form's only printed occurrence of the words 'substance use disorder' is on PAGE 4, inside the definition list of what counts as a 'prior offense' for section 5: 'An equivalent out-of-state deferred prosecution for DUI or Physical Control, including a substance use disorder treatment program. (RCW 46.61.5055(14)(a)(xvi))'. It matches this route's words while answering a different statutory section's question. Reading it as this route's ground would put a DUI prior-offence declaration under a participant asking for RCW 9.96.060(6) relief, on a declaration signed under penalty of perjury.
whyStopped.corroboration: src/lib/rcap-engine/compiled/profiles/WA-washington.json contains zero occurrences of '9.96.060(6)' and zero of 'substance use disorder'; no pathway or rule in it implements this ground. This lane confirmed the route-options block's statement rather than taking it on trust.
whyStopped.whyThisLaneDidNotAnswerIt: Whether a statutory ground falls within a form's residual election is a legal characterisation, not a mapping. The assignment is explicit that a question the controlling record does not settle stops the family with the question named, and that a vehicle or ground the record does not establish is never selected.

rows.andWhyTheGlyphReadingCannotSimplyBeAdded: MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED. scripts/rcap-official-forms/rcap-output-glyph-reading.mjs counts only XObjects named /FlatWidget-N or /ExactFactOverlay-N. Run against all four delivered WA fixtures it returns flattenedWidgetAppearancesReadFromOutputBytes 0 and addedGlyphsReadFromOutputBytes 0 -- while the delivered page 5 plainly prints 'Jordan Avery Reyes' and '118 Maple Street, Springfield, WA 98101'. The WA host writes participant values straight into the page content stream: the delivered bytes contain no `Do` invocation at all and no /AcroForm. So that module's zero on this family would be a FALSE ZERO of exactly the shape DEFECTS_NO_COUNTER_CAN_SEE records, and the honest value by that method is null. Whoever adds these readings to the WA host needs a different measurement, not this module.

howTheSourceWasRendered.renderer: poppler pdftoppm 24.02.0, invoked as `pdftoppm -r 600 -gray -aa yes <pdf> <prefix>`. Poppler draws widget annotations and applies ISO 32000-1 12.5.5; no flag suppressing annotations was passed and none exists on this tool.
howTheSourceWasRendered.threshold: grey < 128 counts as a dark pixel, at 600 dpi, on 5100x6600 letter pages
howTheSourceWasRendered.provedNotAssumed: Proved on the pinned PA-RCRIM-P-490-PETITION (082c515ce5a60de33798508c6dd76589f83758ac2ddd8244e934b379ce05def3) against a control copy with every page /Annots and the catalog /AcroForm removed: page 1 renders 1,865,532 dark pixels normally and 1,862,518 with annotations removed, so 6,032 dark pixels are drawn by ANNOTATIONS ALONE and by nothing in page content, and a further 3,018 page-content dark pixels are COVERED when annotations are drawn. The same command was used for every render in this return.
howTheSourceWasRendered.controlCopyBuiltBy: pdf-lib, page /Annots deleted and catalog /AcroForm dropped; used only as a control and never as a comparison baseline.

rows.aRenderProofSpecificToThisSource: The annotation-free control on CrRLJ 09.0100 page 1 returns 1,156,387 dark pixels with annotations and 1,156,387 without -- 0 drawn by annotations alone and 0 covered. That is NOT a blind render: the same command is independently proved to draw /AP /N ink (6,032 px on the PA source), and this source structurally has nothing to draw. Walking every page /Annots of the pinned CrRLJ 09.0100 with pdf-lib finds ZERO appearance streams: no widget on the form carries an /AP /N at all. So every zero taken from this render is a real zero.
